basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old music enthusiast and IT support specialist living in Toronto, Canada. I recently got into collecting vinyl records, which has been a fun and nostalgic journey. Besides music, I'm a huge fan of The Elder Scrolls game series and enjoy a good stand-up comedy show. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work, and I'm currently single, focusing on my career and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Information Technology and work as an IT support specialist. My interest in music led me to start collecting vinyl records, which I learned about through online forums and local record store events.
